title: soveraeign-ticket-transition/v1
description: A request to change the standing of a soveraeign-ticket/v1 instance. The request is a proposal: it is evaluated against contracts/ticket-transitions.json and either ALLOWED or REFUSED with a declared reason code. An allowed request settles nothing on its own.

ticket.description: Issue reference the transition applies to.

actor_id.description: Attributable identity of the requesting operator. Never a credential.

builder_actor_id.description: Actor that produced the artifact under review. Required for a witness transition so self-witnessing can be refused.

red_operator_actor_id.description: Actor that held the RED stance for the engagement backing a purple receipt.

evidence.description: Evidence keys required by the declared transition, each resolving to a repository address, receipt identifier, or issue reference.

engagementReceipt.description: The settled combination of the verification dyad for one concern, per SDLC.md, Release gate.

dry_rounds.description: Consecutive engagement rounds ending with no new confirmed finding. The declared bounded exit criterion.

finding.description: A Red proposal. It counts only after it reproduces under observation independent of the Red operator and lands as a permanent defeating fixture.

fixture_pointer.description: Permanent defeating fixture in the conformance corpus. Required once a finding is CONFIRMED.

reproduced_by_actor_id.description: Actor that reproduced the finding. Must differ from red_operator_actor_id.

debt_decision_pointer.description: Decision record accepting the residual as named debt, when status is ACCEPTED_AS_DEBT.
